newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLYMPICS-EURO REGIONS IN HISTORIC 2006 GAMES BID.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-EURO REGIONS IN HISTORIC 2006 GAMES BID.

text.p: Three European areas -- Slovenia, the Austrian province of Carinthia and the northeastern Italian region of Friuli-Venezia Giulia -- are to make a joint bid to host the Winter Olympics in 2006.

"This cross-border candidacy is a first in the history of the Games. Three regions, three languages, three cultures: a European dream comes true," Carinthia's liaison office in Brussels said in a statement on Thursday.
Renate Haustrate-Assam, head of the liaison office, said the bid would be officially submitted to the IOC in September or October.
The 2002 Games will be in Salt Lake City in the United States.
